Common Questions

How is your English?
Fluent. I handle complex technical documentation and daily voice stand-ups with ease. No communication barriers. I've worked with UK and US teams for over 5 years.
How do payments work?
I operate as a registered LTD company. You receive a proper invoice compatible with European VAT/Accounting. Payments via SEPA Bank Transfer or Stripe.
Do you sign NDAs?
Absolutely. Your clients will never know I exist. I am white-label by default and happy to sign your standard NDA before we discuss any client specifics.
What if I need to scale up quickly?
I have a network of vetted senior developers here in Morocco that I can bring onto projects if we need to scale velocity, managing them as a lead so you still have a single point of contact.
